name: Liliana Vess
aliases: a pale woman in a violet dress
description: Liliana Vess is a necromancer and planeswalker born on Dominaria, bound by a pact with four demons and carrying the Chain Veil, who commands the dead and pursues her own ends.

description_citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

summary.text: Liliana Vess is a necromancer and planeswalker born on Dominaria, bound by a pact with four demons and carrying the Chain Veil, who commands the dead and pursues her own ends.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

bio.text: She has already used the Chain Veil to kill the demons Kothophed and Griselbrand, and she cannot let go of the veil or silence its whispers.

citations.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.
"Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

bio.text: She was Jace's lover before she betrayed him, she is hunted by the cursed Garruk, and she is pursued by the Raven Man, who taught her and set her on her path.

citations.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

bio.text: On Innistrad she raised an army of the dead and rescued the Gatewatch in Thraben, then swore the Gatewatch oath while planning to use the group.

citations.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.
"Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

bio.text: With the Gatewatch she went after Tezzeret on Kaladesh, learned from him that Bolas was on Amonkhet, and there killed her third demon, Razaketh, by devouring him with possessed crocodiles.

citations.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.
"Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.
"Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

bio.text: When Bolas offered her a way out she abandoned the group, then on Dominaria she unmade her lich brother Josu, killed her last demon Belzenlok with the Blackblade, and was claimed by Bolas through her pact.

citations.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

bio.text: She controlled the Eternals for Bolas in the War of the Spark but turned them against him, and Gideon destroyed himself healing her.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

bio.text: She later became a professor at Strixhaven, first as Professor Onyx and then under her own name, and went to Dominaria to confront the Raven Man and fight Phyrexians.

citations.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.
"Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.
"Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.
"Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

bio.text: In the Reality Fracture story she was held captive in a hexed cell, was freed by Tam, tried to talk Jace down, forgave him, and mourned him before helping haul his body out through a mage-ring.

citations.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.
"Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.
"Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.
"Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

status.text: As of the latest story, Liliana is alive and has left the false Multiverse with Vraska and Jace's body after mourning him.

citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.
"Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana arrives on Shandalar, tormented by the Chain Veil's voices, and heads for the Onakke catacomb she has visited before.
timeline.quote: all she could hear was the veil.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill her demon patron Kothophed and then Griselbrand, and her earlier ill-fated visit to learn of the Onakke.
timeline.quote: Instead of bringing it back to him like a good little retriever, she'd used its power to kill him.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her first visit, when she killed her horse's attacker and used the veil to infect Garruk with shadow, after which he hunted her to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She'd used it to infect him with shadow, polluting his nature magic with the touch of death.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: At the catacomb Liliana kills a guarding angel, who warns her of the Onakke and that she is a vessel.
timeline.quote: She punctuated her words with a killing wave of raw necromantic power that flayed flesh from the angel's bones

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana's tattoos bleed as the Onakke voices fall silent, and she sees a vision of the Onakke city in which a purplish cloud obliterates the ogres.
timeline.quote: A cascade of meteors streaked across the sky as the Onakke were utterly obliterated before her eyes.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana tries to return the Chain Veil to its altar but cannot let go of it.
timeline.quote: She tried to open her hand, to let the thing drop, but her fingers wouldn't obey her will.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises an Onakke skeleton to take the veil, but it will not leave and she destroys it; the veil ends up hanging from her arm.
timeline.quote: She stared at the veil in horror as bones clattered to the floor all around her.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: An Onakke spirit calls her vessel and tells her the root planted when she killed her brother will bloom into destruction; it also says she acts to avoid following Josu into the void.
timeline.quote: Everything you've done has been to avoid following Josu into the void.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains the Chain Veil's power to extinguish the Onakke spirit at great pain but still cannot drop the veil.
timeline.quote: And like a snuffed candle flame, the spirit vanished.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves Shandalar, still carrying the veil and its whispers, fearing she has taken into herself the thing she spent her life avoiding.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had taken into herself the one thing she had spent her whole life trying to avoid.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: The Magic Origins storyline is announced: five Planeswalkers' emotional awakenings, which ignited their sparks, across ten planes.
timeline.quote: Each of these characters experienced an emotional awakening powerful enough to ignite their spark and change their lives forever.

citation.text: "Magic Origins: A New Era" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jun 2015.

timeline.summary: The five origin stories are scheduled in order: Chandra, Liliana, Jace, Gideon, Nissa.
timeline.quote: Over the next five weeks, you'll be able to read all five origin stories in this column.

citation.text: "Magic Origins: A New Era" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jun 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace is surprised to see Liliana knocking at his secret door via the teleportal, and uses an illusion to greet her.
timeline.quote: Jace hadn't seen Liliana Vess since the day he'd realized she was playing him

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana enters, and Jace refuses to trust her after she betrayed him; she reveals she had a spy killed to find him.
timeline.quote: "Nothing you can say will make me trust you," he said. "Not after you betrayed me."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
timeline.quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she hoped they could start over, and Jace plays along, agreeing to dinner.
timeline.quote: I guess I was hoping we could … start over.

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace and Liliana dine at Milena's, where she shows him the Chain Veil and he cannot take it.
timeline.quote: you can't take it, even if I wanted you to.

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, bloodied from battle, interrupts dinner and asks Jace for help with Zendikar.
timeline.quote: "Jace Beleren," he said. "I need your help."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana storms out when Jace agrees to go with Gideon, refusing his invitation to come along.
timeline.quote: "You're out of your mind," she said. "I've got demons to kill."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana walks Ravnica's Second District, hearing the Onakke voices and brooding that Jace chose to help Gideon instead of her.
timeline.quote: But he hadn't. Instead, he had agreed to help Gideon.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill Kothophed and Griselbrand and being unable to leave it behind.
timeline.quote: It was bound to her, and her to it.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana is drawn into a courtyard of ravens and confronts the Raven Man.
timeline.quote: the Raven Man stepped forward from their midst

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man warns Liliana that death is coming for her, citing the demons, the Veil, Garruk and even Jace.
timeline.quote: But death is coming for you, Lili.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts the Raven Man in a flare of magic, then raises the dead ravens as zombies that tear his reformed flock apart and drive him away.
timeline.quote: The bird in her hand squirmed and wriggled free, now a tiny zombie bound to her will.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees blood where her demonic contract lines fade, realizes she is trapped, and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: she pulled open a door between worlds.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace is led to Liliana, who greets him and flicks his nose to check he came in person.
timeline.quote: She reached up to his face...and flicked the tip of his nose.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana disdainfully says there is worse than werewolves out there: angels.
timeline.quote: "Angels," she said with disgust.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace claims he came to apologize for leaving Ravnica with unfinished business.
timeline.quote: I'm here to apologize.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he and Gideon saved a plane and took an oath to keep fighting interplanar threats.
timeline.quote: We even took an oath, to...to keep doing this.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees through Jace and refuses his freely given aid, forcing him to admit he needs something.
timeline.quote: I refuse your freely given aid, Jace Beleren.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he is looking for Sorin Markov, surprising Liliana.
timeline.quote: I'm looking for Sorin Markov,

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her one meeting with Sorin long ago, when he tested and dismissed her and warned her to be a civil guest (recounted).
timeline.quote: He sought me out, tested my strength in battle, and pronounced me too weak to be a threat.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns Jace not to seek Sorin, saying he is ancient, ruthless and powerful.
timeline.quote: And I am telling you, don't go.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns that Markov Manor is even worse, but Jace insists it is his best lead.
timeline.quote: Markov Manor is the best lead I have.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana sets her zombie servants on Jace to make a point.
timeline.quote: Her zombie servants lurched forward.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace the world is dangerous, then releases him and tells him to go home.
timeline.quote: Undead hands released him, and he rose, rubbing his throat.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace to stay the night rather than leave, then teases him that indifference would not quicken his heartbeat.
timeline.quote: doesn't make your heartbeat quicken or your face flush.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: The violet-eyed duplicate reshapes itself into Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: slowly it rearranged itself to a familiar form: Liliana Vess.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace accuses Liliana of redirecting the stones to herd and twist the angels, and she mocks him before vanishing.
timeline.quote: You're the one who redirected the stones to herd the angels here and twist their minds!

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: The Liliana illusion dissipates into the night air.
timeline.quote: it suddenly dissipated into the cold night air.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana broods in her manor during a storm, recalling how she made demonic pacts and used the Chain Veil to kill demons and take Thraben.
timeline.quote: had besieged and taken Thraben itself, the greatest city on Innistrad

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana can no longer bear to wear the Chain Veil, but cannot get rid of it without unbearable pain.
timeline.quote: But when she tried to get rid of it, the pain was unbearable.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man appears beside Liliana as a second voice speaks into her mind.
timeline.quote: He had appeared to her in her youth, taunted her, taught her.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes the intruding voice is Jace, who is invading her mind.
timeline.quote: Are you insane? I almost killed you!

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace binds Liliana's zombies with ropes of light so they cannot reach him.
timeline.quote: ropes of light bound their arms and legs, sent them toppling to the ground.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's death magic passes through a Jace illusion, which pops.
timeline.quote: The bolt of purple light slid right through him, and his image popped like a soap bubble.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace accuses Liliana of helping the angels at the Drownyard.
timeline.quote: And you're helping them. Admit it!

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Jace can see the Raven Man, and strikes the real Jace with a bolt of magic.
timeline.quote: She let loose a bolt of magic at Jace, the real Jace, that left him doubled over in pain.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: The Chain Veil amplifies her magic and backlash racks Liliana as Jace presses his mental assault.
timeline.quote: The backlash started, agony suffusing Liliana as the Chain Veil took its toll.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace she does not want to hurt him; the pounding stops and the Raven Man vanishes in disgust.
timeline.quote: The Raven Man sighed in disgust and disappeared in a rustle of feathers.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, disoriented, tells Liliana about Markov Manor, the moonfolk journal and the stones pointing to a drownyard in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: A drownyard, on the coast.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace theorizes that Liliana is redirecting mana to the Drownyard to be rid of the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: These stone things are redirecting all this mana, and it's all going to this drownyard henge

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana insists she had nothing to do with it, and Jace slumps in relief.
timeline.quote: I really didn't.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace announces he must go to Thraben to find Avacyn; Liliana warns Avacyn will kill him.
timeline.quote: I have to go to Thraben,

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana charges her hand with necromancy, and Jace grabs her wrist and aims it at his chest, daring her to kill him.
timeline.quote: and pointed her glowing palm at his chest.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace through a story of a pet that she would be sad when he dies but would get over it.
timeline.quote: Because that's how I'll feel when you're dead, you idiot,

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gared tells Liliana that his master bids her come to the tower with the Object.
timeline.quote: The Master bids you come to the tower,

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana follows Gared up the tower stairs with the Chain Veil, while a raven watches and vanishes.
timeline.quote: Liliana walked upward, into darkness.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf says Liliana took Mikaeus's body in Thraben and left.
timeline.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, Dierk and Gared try to tame the Chain Veil by channeling lightning and geists through a witchbane orb.
timeline.quote: Liliana's teeth clenched involuntarily as the surge came.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The geist circuit fails to draw off any backlash, and the Veil's pain overwhelms Liliana.
timeline.quote: The geist circuit had not drawn off any of the backlash.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The equipment is ruined and Liliana cries out; she dismisses Dierk, who takes the orb to Olivia.
timeline.quote: You may see yourself out. Deliver the orb back to its owner.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana wants Jace to owe her, then hears a scream and finds werewolves overrunning her throne room.
timeline.quote: Werewolves. Liliana's entire throne room was overrun.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, Gared and the reanimated Dierk reach the door of Lurenbraum Fortress.
timeline.quote: Finally, Liliana, Gared, and—haltingly—Dierk, arrived at the monumental door.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A vampire priest turns Liliana away until Olivia appears and welcomes her.
timeline.quote: Oh Liliana, my dear one!

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia rejoices that Avacyn is dead, a smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: A smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
timeline.quote: set loose more than just the archangel

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana privately recalls that she broke the Helvault open and slew the demon Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: She had slain the demon Griselbrand

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
timeline.quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin threatens Liliana, and she answers that death is hers.
timeline.quote: Innistrad may be your domain, Sorin,

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees the vengeful cloud mass from Nephalia tipping toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: the atmospheric mass shifted slowly from its origin over the Nephalia coast, tipping toward Gavony province and the brightly lit High City.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin says the world is ruined and that Jace will die at Thraben.
timeline.quote: This world is ruined,

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana walks toward Thraben and raises the dead from cemeteries along the road.
timeline.quote: Corpses crawled up out of the earth.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, with a growing horde of zombies, declares she is this world's last hope.
timeline.quote: A dozen more zombies lurched out of the ground, compelled to follow in her wake of necromantic power.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana watches the Gatewatch head into Thraben from above, with Gared and her raised army.
timeline.quote: Those must be Jace's little friends.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's zombie army pours into the square and forms a defensive perimeter around the planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: they parted, formed a defensive perimeter around them, and started pushing outward.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears with the Chain Veil and wipes out the mutated creatures with necromantic energy, rescuing the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Liliana floated forth, arms spread wide, the Chain Veil hovering just beyond her fingertips.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
timeline.quote: "That...thing she carries. It's an abomination."

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace refuses Liliana's demand to planeswalk away, insisting they can finish the job with her help.
timeline.quote: We need to finish this. We're so close.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Jace to decide whether Liliana can be trusted, and Liliana asks what their plan is now.
timeline.quote: So tell me, brave heroes, what's your plan now?

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A moonfolk, Tamiyo, flies into the clearing and silently talks mind to mind with Jace while Liliana watches.
timeline.quote: A moonfolk flew into the clearing, her eyes wide and breath short.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: In Emrakul's presence Liliana wonders whether seeking not to die was the wrong goal, and recalls Josu, Bolas and the Chain Veil as her worst moments.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had been pursuing the wrong goal

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man and the Chain Veil both urge Liliana to flee, frightened of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Whatever Emrakul was, the Chain Veil wanted no part of it.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Fueled by rage, Liliana draws deeply on the Chain Veil, pushes back against Emrakul and takes back her zombies.
timeline.quote: She felt her zombies return to her.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana refuses to be a vessel, silences the Veil and the Raven Man, and prepares to fight Emrakul.
timeline.quote: She shut down the voices of the Veil and the Raven Man both, silencing them abruptly.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts Emrakul back with necromantic energy, believing she is winning.
timeline.quote: For the first time since blossoming, Emrakul was shrinking

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's body begins to fail and Emrakul regrows faster than she can blast it, forcing her onto the defensive.
timeline.quote: now it was all she could do to stand her ground

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man tells Liliana her death is now the best possible outcome and she becomes afraid.
timeline.quote: You have doomed us both.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's zombies are destroyed by the hundreds as she fights only to survive another moment.
timeline.quote: Zombies were destroyed by the hundreds under Emrakul's assault

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace returns to find Liliana unconscious and bleeding, and Emrakul fully unfolded above Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana was on the ground in front of him, unconscious, bleeding profusely from multiple wounds.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, having survived, stares at the moon and curses Emrakul to rot there forever.
timeline.quote: May you rot there forever.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana resolves to treat powerful friends as better zombies and dreams of her own Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: My very own Gatewatch.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity and becomes a member.
timeline.quote: I see that together we're more powerful than we are alone.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana is now a member of the Gatewatch and sees futures full of promise and ambition.
timeline.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana wakes a hungover Chandra at noon in Jace's house.
timeline.quote: Morning, Liliana

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana guesses Chandra spent the night at the Izzet air races.
timeline.quote: You went to see the Izzet air races.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana notes Nissa has barely left the roof garden since the first morning.
timeline.quote: She's been staying in the roof garden ever since.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she keeps her own lodgings because she dislikes relying on others, hiding that she will not sleep under a roof Jace paid for.
timeline.quote: I mislike relying on the mercy of others

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana bristles that Nissa gets apologies while she once had to learn to break fingers.
timeline.quote: Two hundred years ago, she'd had to learn to break fingers.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana reflects that Jace swore Lavinia to secrecy about planeswalking, and Lavinia guards him to keep him from leaving.
timeline.quote: to swear her to secrecy

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana makes Jace drop his tidy glamour, revealing him tired and unkempt.
timeline.quote: You can drop the glamour, dear. No one cares.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Baan the Gatewatch handles outside threats, not internal ones, so its hands are tied.
timeline.quote: our hands are tied.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan accepts Liliana's reasoning and prepares to leave.
timeline.quote: I did not fully comprehend the strictures you operate under.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains a planeswalking gorgon assassin with a grudge against the Azorius swore she would return.
timeline.quote: About a year ago, there was a gorgon assassin operating on Ravnica.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls that she and Jace once worked for Tezzeret's Consortium (backstory).
timeline.quote: when she and Jace had worked for Tezzeret's criminal Consortium

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana feels the Chain Veil in its hidden pocket and the whispering spirits inside it.
timeline.quote: She laid a hand over the hidden pocket where she kept the Chain Veil.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he hates it when she takes over, and she answers that she remembers when he enjoyed that.
timeline.quote: I remember when you enjoyed that.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra rushes past Baan and Gideon, apologizing for blowing up the punching bag.
timeline.quote: SorryIblewupyourthingy

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra hiding in an alley and persuades her to come along shopping.
timeline.quote: She was crouched halfway down an alley three blocks from Jace's home

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana invites Chandra to join her and talk on the way.
timeline.quote: Then I suppose you'll have to come along and see.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Lavinia reports that Liliana and Chandra spent the afternoon in the market district and then planeswalked together.
timeline.quote: They spent the afternoon wandering the market district

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears on the balcony next to Chandra, having followed her.
timeline.quote: Standing on the formerly unoccupied balcony next to her was Liliana

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana persuades Chandra to celebrate her return while still looking for the renegade.
timeline.quote: Then I think it's high time we celebrated your grand return to your hometown.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra's search turns into mingling with inventors and dancing.
timeline.quote: Chandra's and Liliana's search for the renegade had become a series of chats with renegade sympathizers

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana throws her drink in a Consulate vedalken's face and introduces Chandra as a renegade sympathizer.
timeline.quote: tossing her drink into the vedalken's face

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana flee out the back of the nightclub.
timeline.quote: Chandra hopped a guardrail and ducked through the back of the nightclub.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra shows Liliana a worn mosaic of her father Kiran and says her parents were killed when she was a child.
timeline.quote: They were killed when I was a child.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra blames a uniformed officer named Baral for her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: My parents died because of him.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges Chandra to find Baral and burn him, and Chandra swears he will pay.
timeline.quote: I swear he's going to pay for what he did.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chased by Consulate guards, Chandra refuses Liliana's lethal option and blocks the alley with a wall of fire.
timeline.quote: spreading into a wall of fire that spanned the alley's width

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana jump onto the Aradara dawn train to escape.
timeline.quote: Chandra ran and stepped up, putting her hand in the way as the doors tried to close.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns open the train door and they leap off to reach the disruption.
timeline.quote: Chandra hot-punched the door handle.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra calls to the hooded man, who runs away through the crowd.
timeline.quote: he dashed away from them, through a bank of onlookers and around a Consulate checkpoint.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana grabs the man and names him Tezzeret with disgust.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and names Tezzeret, and he names her Vess in return.
timeline.quote: A pale woman clad in dark flowing silks and a glinting golden headpiece appeared opposite the Head Judge.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Chandra they must retreat as the soldiers drag Pia away.
timeline.quote: They have her! You can't risk it now; we have to go!

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls Jace's scars when she thinks of Tezzeret and warns he is dangerous.
timeline.quote: Jace, his back stitched with ugly white scars from a manablade.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa angrily confronts Liliana for leaving without telling the others.
timeline.quote: Why did you leave without letting us know?

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana cruelly tells Nissa that Chandra ran from her and came to Liliana.
timeline.quote: She ran from you

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and tells Jace that Tezzeret is alive and well on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret. Alive and well.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana demands that Jace come to Kaladesh and bring the muscle, then planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Come to Kaladesh. Bring the muscle.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks what the Gatewatch is.
timeline.quote: What's a Gatewatch?

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
timeline.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
timeline.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra compresses a blinding point of fire to kill Tezzeret as Liliana urges her on.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist closed, compressing fire into a tiny point of blinding, seething heat.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana arrive at the Inventors' Fair and pursue a suspicious cloaked figure.
timeline.quote: they pursue the person through the Fair.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves to alert the Gatewatch while Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri go to the Dhund, where Baral traps them in a cell filling with poison.
timeline.quote: He traps the would-be rescuers in a cell that rapidly fills with poison.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
timeline.quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni warns that the Consulate is on its way and offers their penthouse as a safe hideout; the group agrees.
timeline.quote: My penthouse is safe.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon confronts Liliana for killing Consulate forces; she argues death is a tool and they had to.
timeline.quote: "We don't kill."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana says there is just one person she wants to kill on this plane and tells Gideon Tezzeret destroyed something that was hers.
timeline.quote: "He hurt something important to me. Destroyed something that was mine."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
timeline.quote: "We all heard the commotion."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana volunteers to infiltrate with Saheeli; Gideon reluctantly agrees and tells her to do what is right.
timeline.quote: "Fine. Liliana will go."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli rescues Rashmi in her construct and tells her Mitul is safe.
timeline.quote: "He's safe," Saheeli said.

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon watches the Skysovereign sink; Jace and Kari have broken the blockade, and Gideon insists the target is the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: "It's fallen," Gideon said. "And the blockade's gone with it.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana convinces a reluctant Gideon that she must go alone and unarmed to duel and distract Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: I have to go alone, unarmed, or else your whole plan falls apart.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana arrives in the war-torn streets of Ghirapur, recalling Caligo Forest, resolved to kill Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret had to die.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls working for Bolas and turning Jace against Tezzeret, and Jace wrecking Tezzeret's mind on Ravnica four years ago.
timeline.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises a dead renegade as a zombie bodyguard.
timeline.quote: She waved a hand in its direction, and a new zombie struggled to its feet.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana notes the vortex of energy around the Spire and guesses Tezzeret has activated the portal.
timeline.quote: Liliana guessed that Tezzeret had activated that portal.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana stuns the Consulate soldiers at a barricade without killing them and enters the Spire.
timeline.quote: just enough mana to suck the breath from their lungs until their vision went black and their knees buckled

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana attacks Tezzeret in the portal chamber; a scrap construct shields him.
timeline.quote: a hulk of sharp-edged metal detached itself from the heaps of junk around the edges of the room

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret claims credit for Rashmi's invention and taunts Liliana about Jace and the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She would have been sending vases across Ghirapur forever if I hadn't guided her tiny little mind.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains Tezzeret's life using the Chain Veil and her zombie attacks him.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret clutched at his throat and fell to his knees

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Tezzeret is working for Bolas to pay a debt.
timeline.quote: "Oh," Liliana breathed. "Oh. You're here for Bolas."

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana pins Tezzeret under her heel and forces him to reveal Bolas is on Amonkhet, home of the demon Razaketh.
timeline.quote: "Razaketh," he gasped.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes she must eventually confront Razaketh, one of two remaining demons, and says Amonkhet aloud.
timeline.quote: "Amonkhet," she said aloud. "He's on Amonkhet."

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The oversized thopter bursts toward the Spire with Chandra's red hair visible at its tip.
timeline.quote: she caught a glimpse as she ducked behind the wall, of flaming red hair at the tip of the oversized thopter.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The explosion destroys Tezzeret's gate and buries Liliana in rubble; Tezzeret's fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: A huge column of smoke boiled up from where Tezzeret's gate had stood.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana searches the rubble and reflects that she needs Chandra and the Gatewatch as powerful tools to free herself from her demons.
timeline.quote: She needed powerful people, and she'd found them.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra and Gideon alive; Tezzeret is either buried or has fled to his master.
timeline.quote: "He's either buried in this rubble or run home to his master."

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: At Yahenni's penthouse the Gatewatch gather before the party; Gideon forces himself to smile.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, even here where no one but his friends could see him, Gideon smiled.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana's briefing on Tezzeret and Amonkhet leads the Gatewatch to discuss stopping Bolas, whom Liliana says controls and may have created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: "Bolas controls the place completely. As far as I know, he created it."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch, except an unsure Nissa, vote to strike at Bolas now; Gideon decides to meet Ajani after facing Bolas.
timeline.quote: "Then we'll meet Ajani there...after we face Bolas."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch's five planeswalkers appear in the middle of an Amonkhet sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Five figures stood where none were moments ago, caught by surprise in the blinding sands.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on a Kaladesh rooftop, after Ajani leaves, the Gatewatch plans to go to Amonkhet, with Liliana navigating, to find and stop Bolas.
timeline.quote: We go to Amonkhet and learn what we can of Nicol Bolas's plans, then neutralize the threat he poses

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the five planeswalk from Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: We traveled infinitely far yet not at all, standing still yet moving at blinding speeds.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group from the storm.
timeline.quote: I step forward and shape the still-liquid glass into a simple, crude dome.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she knows little of where Bolas is; Nissa senses the plane's leylines are weak, and Chandra spots Bolas's horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: the massive shadow of two horns pierces the sky

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Undead burst from the sand and grab Jace; the group fights a horde while Liliana commands undead to obey, assist and flee.
timeline.quote: rotting hands burst forth from the sand, grabbed Jace by the legs, and pulled him under.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Giant sand wurms erupt, and one swallows Liliana whole.
timeline.quote: I watched in horror she disappeared into the gullet of an enormous wurm.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusion lures a wurm away and Liliana emerges from a dying wurm, wreathed in the Chain Veil's purple light, then collapses.
timeline.quote: I watch, horrified, as Liliana steps forward out of the wurm

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Two zombified wurms attack; one coils around Nissa while Liliana lies in danger, forcing Gideon to choose.
timeline.quote: I stood, suspended, for a fraction of a second, fully aware that not making a choice meant choosing death for them both.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: A blazing white arrow kills the wurm over Liliana and a towering jackal-headed figure destroys the others and saves the group.
timeline.quote: She towered above me, standing at the height of a dozen men, golden headdress gleaming in the sun

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: The group reaches a ridge and sees a barrier-shielded city of obelisks and temples on a river.
timeline.quote: all of which formed a sprawling city that spanned as far as we could see.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decides to descend toward the city and its barrier.
timeline.quote: "Only one way to find out."

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana rots a living-wood Gearhulk to pieces.
timeline.quote: She snapped her fingers, and the Gearhulk fell to pieces at her feet.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon sees Consulate thopters approaching the Hub and rushes back.
timeline.quote: "Get back to the Hub!" he shouted, breaking into a run.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
timeline.quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra clear zombies at the dome and Jace and Nissa open a hole in the Hekma, and the group enters the city.
timeline.quote: a hole a little wider than Jace's outstretched arms opened to admit them.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana charms Temmet by claiming they were on a mission for the Horned One, and the group learns the standard greeting.
timeline.quote: "We have been out in the desert for some time," she said, "on a special mission for the Horned One."

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Temmet leads them through the city, where they see people training and the Anointed doing all labor.
timeline.quote: "The Anointed perform all the work here, so the living need do nothing but train.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon promises to quietly investigate and says there is no deception in Oketra, while Jace and Liliana doubt gods.
timeline.quote: But there is no deception in Oketra.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Temmet explains the woman was pursued by viziers of Bontu and her crop was due for a trial; the group wonders if the people are being harvested.
timeline.quote: "She proved herself unworthy of life among us."

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: A mummy bursts in with breakfast, startling the group.
timeline.quote: a white-bandaged mummy burst through the door carrying a tray of bread and a carafe of what smelled like ale.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana lounges in a shaded tent, served by mummies, thinking of her hunt for Razaketh and of Nicol Bolas, who brokered her demonic contracts.
timeline.quote: Razaketh would make three.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man appears and chides Liliana for sending shades to search rather than looking herself, and presses her to stay focused on her demon.
timeline.quote: One of your demons is in reach, and time is running out.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man reveals that he took command of the Chain Veil to blast Liliana out of the wurm's belly when she arrived on Amonkhet, which she did not know.
timeline.quote: Didn't I take command of the Chain Veil to blast you out of that wurm's belly when you arrived here?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns the Raven Man to vanish as Jace approaches, and he disappears indignantly.
timeline.quote: "Don't forget why you're here," he said, and vanished indignantly.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace finds Liliana at her tent and they discuss the strange mummies and ambient necromancy of the city.
timeline.quote: it's possible they were raised by some kind of ambient necromancy.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: A shade reports it has found something, and Liliana leads Jace through the city, noticing that all the mummies are maimed.
timeline.quote: Have you noticed that all the mummies in the city are maimed?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The shade stops at a wall of inscriptions bearing Razaketh's name, which makes Liliana sway.
timeline.quote: The inscription swam in her vision, and whispers pawed at the edges of her awareness.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Hiding in an alcove, Liliana and Jace watch mummies carry the freshly slain bodies of initiates down the corridor.
timeline.quote: The mummies carried the bodies of initiates slain in combat, dripping blood, wrapped in rags.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: They follow the mummies into the central chamber and see embalming on an industrial scale, which Liliana judges purely practical rather than religious.
timeline.quote: Not a religious rite. Purely practical.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: A corpse stirs before it is wrapped and the mummies silence it by pressing a metal cartouche to its chest.
timeline.quote: They pressed the cartouche into place on the body's chest.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: At a mural of the afterlife, Liliana and Jace see Razaketh depicted guarding the gate as the final test.
timeline.quote: Beyond the gate, Razaketh. Beyond Razaketh, paradise.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she is hunting Razaketh, and Jace angrily accuses her of breaking the Gatewatch's trust by hiding her demons.
timeline.quote: You broke our trust.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The carving of Razaketh opens its eyes and the mummies whisper Liliana's name, then attack her and Jace.
timeline.quote: The carving of Razaketh . . . opened its eyes.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes that an ambient magic raises all the dead on Amonkhet and that the mummies are controlled physically through the cartouches.
timeline.quote: There was something on this world—natural or artificial, it hardly mattered—that raised the dead.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Jace wrench a cartouche from a mummy, which bursts with white light and falls apart, and the mummies then surround them.
timeline.quote: The hole left by the cartouche burned with blinding white light, and the mummy fell apart.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Temmet arrives, commanding the mummies, and reveals he checked the birth records and knows the pair are outsiders.
timeline.quote: But I checked the birth records at the Monument of Knowledge,

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana says they have met the Horned One, and Temmet has the mummies choke her in rage.
timeline.quote: We've met him, actually,

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace takes control of Temmet's mind, and through him the mummies, then urges Liliana to run.
timeline.quote: Jace was controlling Temmet, and Temmet was controlling the mummies

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Jace flee the embalming chamber; Liliana says Razaketh knows she is here and only the Chain Veil stops him activating her contract, and Jace admits Temmet will remember what he saw.
timeline.quote: Chain Veil's the only reason he can't . . . activate my contract.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana decides she needs the others and runs from her demon toward help.
timeline.quote: She ran, away from her demon, toward help.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
timeline.quote: My third demon is here.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
timeline.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The demon calls out for Liliana Vess, saying she cannot hide.
timeline.quote: I know you are here, Liliana Vess. You cannot hide from me.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana waits at the bloody Luxa and contacts Jace in her mind as Razaketh calls out for her.
timeline.quote: Jace? Can you hear me?

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh scans the crowd and Liliana finds her hand moving involuntarily.
timeline.quote: The movement of her hand had been . . . involuntary.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh spots Liliana and the Gatewatch arrive, bruised from the arena.
timeline.quote: Liliana saw the rest of the Gatewatch arrive.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh commands Liliana to come to him, and her body wades into the river of blood against her will; Chandra and Nissa are repelled by necromantic energy.
timeline.quote: her body waded forward into the river of blood.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana is forced beneath the surface of the blood river, and the Raven Man tells her she can only survive if she kills the demon.
timeline.quote: You are only free if you kill each of your demons, Liliana.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana's body swims itself across to the Necropolis bank, where Razaketh stands smugly above her.
timeline.quote: She had crossed the river and crawled onto the opposite bank.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh toys with Liliana, making her kneel, nod and bark, and tells her he has fulfilled a friend's assignment.
timeline.quote: I love a dog who comes when she is called.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana regains her speech and tells Razaketh he has five minutes to live, then counts down to stall until her allies arrive.
timeline.quote: You have five more minutes to live,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra engulfs Razaketh in fire at Liliana's signal, and he rams her into the Necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: a jet of fire engulfed the demon.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh dislocates Liliana's shoulder and silences her until Nissa's elemental breaks his concentration.
timeline.quote: A massive elemental emerged, its body forming from the banks of the river.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh stops Liliana's breathing and paralyzes her as Chandra takes aim at him.
timeline.quote: She tried to suck in air, but her diaphragm was completely still.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, camouflaged by Jace, slashes Razaketh's back with his sural, freeing Liliana's breath and shielding her with his invulnerability.
timeline.quote: carving three thick lines in Razaketh's back.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace breaks Razaketh's control over Liliana's mind.
timeline.quote: Got him, move fast,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana draws the Chain Veil but puts it away, choosing to defeat Razaketh with her own power.
timeline.quote: Let the demon witness what terror she could wield all on her own.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the dead animals of the river against Razaketh and blasts him down.
timeline.quote: a menagerie of death spilled up and out of the river of blood.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana possesses two dozen dead crocodiles and devours Razaketh, killing him.
timeline.quote: her two dozen selves consumed the last of the demon Razaketh.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace is horrified as Liliana laughs and relishes the killing, and he tells her to stop.
timeline.quote: Liliana, that's enough

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana releases the crocodiles, which swim away reanimated by the Curse of Wandering.
timeline.quote: The Curse of Wandering had taken hold.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace she ate Razaketh and that only one demon remains; Jace does not answer.
timeline.quote: And now there's just one more.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Chandra approach coldly, and Nissa warns that the bloodspell began a chain reaction that sets the Hours in motion.
timeline.quote: The Hours' that herald Nicol Bolas's return needed to be set in motion by the demon.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he will not stand by if she loses control like that again.
timeline.quote: I'm not going to stand by if you lose it like that again.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra glimpses Gideon and Liliana running past, and Djeru tells her not to stop.
timeline.quote: One was Gideon, the broad-shouldered warrior Oketra had claimed as one of her own.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, in rage, demands they fight Bolas at once, and the Gatewatch attack with everything they have.
timeline.quote: They began. Gideon charged, his golden force shield shimmering

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana, shaken by Jace's scream, is torn between the Chain Veil's urging and the Raven Man's counsel as Bolas taunts her.
timeline.quote: Yes, use us. Unleash your full power

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers to teach Liliana to master the Chain Veil and tells her to go if she wants to live.
timeline.quote: I can help you unlock its power, Liliana.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
timeline.quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana vanishes into the void as Chandra screams at her betrayal.
timeline.quote: She surrounded herself in a glowing nimbus of dark energy and vanished into the void

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace reflects that Liliana never called him incredible, unlike Vraska.
timeline.quote: Liliana never told Jace he was incredible.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace chooses to track Gideon rather than Liliana to reach Dominaria.
timeline.quote: What he felt for her now wasn't anything resembling affection.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dominaria coalesced around Gideon and the first thing that struck him was the stench of rotting plants and dank earth.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, wounded in the shoulder, admits the battle against Bolas did not go to plan.
timeline.quote: The second thing Gideon noticed was the hole in his shoulder and its piercing pain.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks where Jace is and Nissa says he has given up.
timeline.quote: He's given up.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Nissa accuses Liliana of running after killing her demon Razaketh and using the group to free herself.
timeline.quote: You got what you wanted and ran.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits her last demon, Belzenlok, is on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok is here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana asks Nissa to rouse Yavimaya's treefolk against the Cabal's Stronghold while she uses the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: And I can use the Chain Veil to kill him.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Nissa refuses and walks away, declaring her watch over.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry, but my watch is over.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Nissa planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nissa was already stepping out of the plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra announces she will leave to become stronger.
timeline.quote: I'm going too.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks away in a rush of fire.
timeline.quote: Her form disappeared in a rush of fire as she walked from the plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon decides to stay and work with Liliana.
timeline.quote: I'm staying.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the town is her birthplace.
timeline.quote: It's where I was born.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: At the inn, Liliana tends Gideon's wound while the innkeeper says the Cabal has taken over the region.
timeline.quote: It's the Cabal,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The innkeeper says the Church of Serra was routed by the Cabal in a battle days earlier.
timeline.quote: The Church of Serra came to help and there was a great battle only a few days ago, but the Cabal routed us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana asks a girl if anyone remembers the House of Vess.
timeline.quote: Does anyone here remember the House of Vess?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gathering herbs, Liliana remembers meeting the Raven Man in the marsh.
timeline.quote: This was where she had first met the Raven Man.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls how her attempt to heal Josu raised him as an undead who killed Lady Ana before she fled as her spark ignited (flashback).
timeline.quote: She had meant only to heal him, and instead turned him into a mindless undead monster that killed Lady Ana, killed her servants
