citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Vess Manor still standing.
timeline.quote: The house was still here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds charred necromantic symbols and blood, convincing her it was no coincidence.
timeline.quote: Whatever had happened here, it was no coincidence.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Cabal undead knights attack the town at nightfall.
timeline.quote: She had barely started on the path through the ruins when she sensed the surge of undead malice.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana destroys a dozen knights with necromantic bolts.
timeline.quote: As the etchings on her skin flared violet, bolts shot out from her hands to strike a dozen black-armored knights.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana seizes an undead knight and saves Gideon.
timeline.quote: In the next instant, he was hers.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tracing the knight's connection, Liliana sees the lich's face is Josu's.
timeline.quote: An image of the lich's face burned before her. The face was Josu's.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: A captured cleric reveals Belzenlok made Josu his servant and commander of his forces.
timeline.quote: He has made your precious brother into his servant, the commander of his unholy forces!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The cleric dies after saying the Void awaits.
timeline.quote: and slumped lifeless on the pavement.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to free Josu and make Belzenlok pay.
timeline.quote: You'll pay for this, Belzenlok,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana searches the Morass for the Raven Man, shouting for him to face her.
timeline.quote: I know you're here! Face me, damn you!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man appears from a swirl of ravens.
timeline.quote: Out of that mass stepped the Raven Man.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man says Josu cannot be laid to rest and that Liliana should have followed him.
timeline.quote: It can't be done.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man vanishes with his ravens.
timeline.quote: he and every raven in sight abruptly vanished.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Belzenlok used Josu to make her too weak to use the Chain Veil against him.
timeline.quote: He knew if Liliana used the Chain Veil to unmake Josu, it would leave her so weak she wouldn't be able to use it to destroy Belzenlok.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the lich leading the Cabal is her brother Josu.
timeline.quote: The lich leading the Cabal forces in this area is my brother, Josu.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana confesses she made Josu undead as a girl.
timeline.quote: I made Josu undead, many years ago.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon agrees to help lay Josu to rest as the next step.
timeline.quote: Yes, that's our next step, obviously.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana find Rael in a ruin and offer help against the Cabal.
timeline.quote: We know you're Rael, Battle Angel and Protector of Caligo.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Rael accepts and asks to hear their plan.
timeline.quote: Tell me your plan.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Corin to make a dread shade mistake him for a skin witch.
timeline.quote: Corin, with Liliana's help, could you create an illusion? Make a dread shade think I'm a skin witch?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls to Josu through the wind, drawing him to the manor.
timeline.quote: Josu Vess, I am here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Josu appears in spiked dark armor as Belzenlok's lich general.
timeline.quote: The magic that had transformed him from a mindless undead remnant into Belzenlok's lich general had covered his shape with dark metal armor.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana draws on the Chain Veil, killing undead across the Morass.
timeline.quote: The Onakke bound into the Chain Veil whispered in her mind as she drew on raw power.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.quote: crumpled before her on the paving stones was the decomposing corpse of her brother.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: With his last words Josu blames Liliana for the curse of the House of Vess.
timeline.quote: You killed me. You killed them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes her family died trying to end the evil she created.
timeline.quote: And worse still, her family, all dead trying to end the evil she had created.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to destroy Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: I will pry open his Stronghold, slaughter his grimnants, and destroy his legacy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra Dawnbringer refuses Liliana entry to Benalia City.
timeline.quote: Your companion stinks of death magic and will not be allowed into this city.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra relents after reading Rael's letter vouching for Liliana.
timeline.quote: Very well. You may enter the city.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight descends to the signal tower to pick up Gideon and Liliana.
timeline.quote: as the giant skyship dropped down toward them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani scolds Gideon and Liliana for going to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: You should not have gone to Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon says they failed on Amonkhet because Liliana's demon pact held her back.
timeline.quote: But we failed on Amonkhet because Liliana was still hamstrung by her demon pact.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana angrily reveals how much Caligo's ruin matters to her.
timeline.quote: You didn't see what he did to Caligo!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers the Weatherlight's help to destroy Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: I've had this ship reconstructed for the sole purpose of fighting the Cabal

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group resolves to capture a high-level Cabal agent for intelligence about the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We need to capture a high-level Cabal agent.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira tenses when she sees her ex-lover Jodah at the academy.
timeline.quote: Just an ex-lover I wasn't expecting to see today.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah brings them to see something at the academy.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure how much we can help you, but there's something we'd like you to take a look at.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana animates a dead student to question it; nine victims were killed by dementia magic.
timeline.quote: Lying on the floor were nine corpses, students and staff of the academy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana concludes a Cabal cleric used dementia magic.
timeline.quote: It's dementia magic all around, I'm afraid,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna argues the killings are not how Cabal agents operate.
timeline.quote: I've hunted Cabal agents in the cities of Jamuraa, and this is not how they operate.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes the laboratory itself was the agent's target.
timeline.quote: This place was the target all along.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana, Gideon and Shanna subdue Thom.
timeline.quote: She knocked him flat and Gideon stepped forward to kick the magical device away from his hand.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she sees Josu all the time now.
timeline.quote: I see Josu all the time, now.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira describes the Blackblade as a soul-drinker made with death magic.
timeline.quote: But it's a soul-drinker, created with death magic, and steals the life-energy of everyone it kills.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon refuses to use a soul-drinker under any circumstances.
timeline.quote: A soul-drinker is not something we would want to use, under any circumstances.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira says she knows a time mage who can help.
timeline.quote: But I know just the time mage who can.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira introduces Gideon and Liliana as planeswalkers to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Liliana are Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Liliana mistakes can eventually be balanced.
timeline.quote: It isn't possible to erase them, but with effort you can eventually balance your account.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira theorizes Urza cheated, and Liliana looks for ghosts in the chamber.
timeline.quote: Worse, I think he cheated,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana detects trapped spirits that factor into the puzzle.
timeline.quote: Aha, there are spirits here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi hits the correct square and the platform opens.
timeline.quote: the square in the center slid ponderously aside to reveal an opening.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The monument begins to collapse.
timeline.quote: I think this place is collapsing!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra recognizes Gideon and Liliana aboard the Weatherlight as they call the group to come aboard.
timeline.quote: "Gideon!" She waved wildly.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon and Chandra to leave with him and says Liliana cannot be trusted, but Gideon refuses and Chandra chooses to stay.
timeline.quote: You don't understand. You can't trust her.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon agrees to use the Blackblade if it can be found in Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: If we can find it in the Stronghold, I'll use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Gideon argue over whether Gideon should have told Chandra about Josu to push her to help kill Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: Because she agrees with us that it has to be done before we face Nicol Bolas again.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot and its sprouts leave their den and meet Liliana, who asks Arvad how he resisted drinking blood.
timeline.quote: How did you decide not to eat people?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad explains he held on to an image of himself before he was changed, and Liliana learns there is no trick; she threatens Tiana and Arvad not to tell anyone about the talk.
timeline.quote: And if you tell anyone we had this conversation, you'll both regret it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
timeline.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Urborg resistance's hidden base and that her owl has arranged a meeting.
timeline.quote: And the resistance has agreed to meet with us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff casts an illusion that gives Chandra a sword scar for her Cabal bounty hunter disguise.
timeline.quote: Her skin puckered and pulled, creating a sword scar that ran from one side of her forehead to her jaw.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana says she wants her pact removed and Belzenlok in pieces.
timeline.quote: I want this pact off my body. I want Belzenlok in pieces.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls the dead of an old massacre site to raise an undead army as a diversion.
timeline.quote: And in the grass and reeds and brush below, the dead stirred.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana's panther liches pledge to follow the Weatherlight into battle.
timeline.quote: They'll follow the ship into battle.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle rises from the swamp, a living creature that killed all the panther warriors, and flings itself at the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then Yargle roared and flung itself at the Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana saves Jhoira from falling from the tilting deck.
timeline.quote: Liliana managed to wedge herself between the deck and the rail, gripping Jhoira's arm to keep her from falling.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental, rises behind Yargle and seizes it.
timeline.quote: It's Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira directs the ship to the Stronghold after Slimefoot's call for help succeeds.
timeline.quote: Jhoira agreed. It was time to end this. "To the Stronghold."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.
timeline.quote: Teferi held out his hand and the gate across the causeway turned red with corrosion, then dissolved in a puff of rust.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros rises from the volcano on a dragon-like mount to attack the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: I think that's Urgoros!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana deflects Urgoros's spear to save Liliana, and Jaya, Karn, Tiana and Arvad drive it off the ship.
timeline.quote: Tiana suddenly landed in front of her.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira realizes Urgoros is only a distraction, and the spirits build a tower of bodies to lower Liliana to the ground.
timeline.quote: They kept coming, the tower of spirit bodies rising higher and higher.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana taunts Belzenlok about her brother and the pact signers she has killed to draw him away from Gideon.
timeline.quote: You should have left my brother alone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok knocks Gideon down, but the Blackblade pierces his thigh and Liliana grabs the hilt.
timeline.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains Belzenlok's life with the Blackblade and kills him; his body collapses into lumps of flesh.
timeline.quote: What was left of Belzenlok collapsed into lumps of white flesh.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds the lines of her pact are still on her skin after Belzenlok's death.
timeline.quote: but the lines of her pact were still written on her skin.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.quote: You seem unaware that with your demons dead, your contract defaults to its broker.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas planeswalks away and Liliana follows, resolved to find an escape while staying alive.
timeline.quote: Sick at heart, bound like a prisoner to a new incarnation of a fate she had schemed so long to cheat, Liliana followed in his wake.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon returns to the empty Stronghold court, finds Liliana's aether trail leading away from the others, and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She had left Dominaria, but she hadn't followed him and the others.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.quote: the army stopped as one and turned to look her way

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The raven-haired woman watches the planeswalkers and Rat fight, then leaves for the pyramid.
timeline.quote: her shaking her head in pity, if not disgust

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out five problems: the Beacon, the Immortal Sun, the Planar Bridge, Liliana Vess, and Bolas himself.
timeline.quote: We face a number of problems. Five to be exact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace identifies Liliana Vess as controlling the Eternals for Bolas and says she must be stopped forever, to Gideon's silence.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess. She's clearly controlling the Eternals for Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana and the God-Eternal Oketra shoot Gideon's pegasus, and he falls behind the Citadel.
timeline.quote: Instead its six-foot length impaled his mount.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana turns the Eternals against Bolas, switching sides.
timeline.quote: I knew then that Miss Raven-Hair had switched sides.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana begins to disintegrate; Gideon heals her by taking her death into himself and is destroyed.
timeline.quote: In exchange, her black death was transferring over to him.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Oketra is destroyed, and Bontu bites Bolas and harvests all his Sparks, exploding.
timeline.quote: Bontu began harvesting all the Sparks the Elderspell had granted the dragon.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana picks up the gem and planeswalks away; others begin leaving.
timeline.quote: Then she stood up again and, in a cloud of black, planeswalked away.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana, teaching as Professor Onyx, walks the Biblioplex unrecognized by the other professors.
timeline.quote: the other professors of Strixhaven hadn't recognized Liliana Vess when she introduced herself by an entirely different name

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana identifies the intruder as one of the Oriq, who warns her that her days are numbered.
timeline.quote: Then you know that your days are numbered.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Talonrook interrupts, and the intruder vanishes.
timeline.quote: When she turned back, the intruder was gone.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Deans Lisette and Nassari she saw a masked stranger, but they dismiss the rumors.
timeline.quote: I saw a stranger in a mask on campus.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana notices the twins mention Kylem and wonders if they are planeswalkers who could be useful.
timeline.quote: They probably weren't Oriq agents.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Tavver recalls the professor with violet eyes who meant to kill him in a fight over a book Extus wanted.
timeline.quote: Tavver had seen true darkness in that professor's violet eyes.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.quote: She had neither as she approached the tangled grove where Beledros Witherbloom made her home.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.quote: What would it take for such methods to work on humans?

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana begs Beledros to help give Gideon back his life.
timeline.quote: He took my death. Help me give him back his life.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Beledros refuses to help.
timeline.quote: I cannot.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Beledros tells Liliana that how we honor the dead is reflected in how we treat the living.
timeline.quote: how we honor the dead is reflected in how we treat the living

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana returns empty-handed from Caerdoon and runs into Oriq agents capturing a white stag.
timeline.quote: Liliana pressed against the gnarled trunk of an old tree and watched as the band of Oriq agents surrounded a large white stag.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana abandons her fruitless search for a way to revive Gideon and reflects on destiny.
timeline.quote: There wasn't a book or scroll or spell in Strixhaven that could bring Gideon back.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees Rowan Kenrith with friends and decides to take her professor role more seriously.
timeline.quote: Maybe it's time to take my role as a Professor a little more seriously.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Will confronts Rowan at Bow's End about barely passing Professor Onyx's exam.
timeline.quote: You barely passed, Rowan

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx stops the fight and takes the twins to her office.
timeline.quote: He squinted as he looked up, meeting Professor Onyx's gaze.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx warns the twins about the Oriq and hints Strixhaven does not hold all power on the plane, leaving Will suspecting she is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Strixhaven doesn't have a monopoly on power in this plane.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina finds an esis seedling in Professor Onyx's classroom and takes a root sliver for the ritual.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx grades exams and recalls her strict mentor Lady Ana.
timeline.quote: Professor Serafina Onyx blew air at the flame, causing it to dance.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Lisette returns the chained tome to Onyx, furious.
timeline.quote: I believe this is yours

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Lisette threatens to remove Onyx from the school, and Onyx says it can be arranged.
timeline.quote: And I'll die before I stop trying to get you as far away from this school as I can.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana reflects an Oriq life-draining spell back onto its caster, killing him.
timeline.quote: With a gesture, Liliana sent it racing back toward the caster, twice as hungry as before.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Kianne spears a mage hunter with a lance of force.
timeline.quote: Kianne sent a geometric lance of force piercing through it.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana spots a man in a red uniform with mandible-like features who commands the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: He locked eyes with her, and with eerie coordination, all of the other mage hunters surged toward them.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes the campus-wide attack is a distraction.
timeline.quote: An attack all across the campus, with no apparent aim but destruction and chaos.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx kills an Oriq agent aiming at the twins.
timeline.quote: When she opened them, she saw the Oriq splayed across the ground.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx tells them the mage hunters have formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: They've formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.quote: No. I'm not quite so responsible as that. And I need help.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx opens an old maintenance passage she found as a student.
timeline.quote: It's an old maintenance passage I found when I was a student.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx explains Extus leads the Oriq and is responsible for the attack.
timeline.quote: The man responsible for all of this. The leader of the Oriq.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx reveals she is leading them to where the most damage could be done.
timeline.quote: I'm taking you where I would go, if I wanted to cause the most damage possible.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The twins zap and ice-bind Oriq agents as Liliana leads them to the Snarl.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana senses that Extus has bound himself to the Snarl.
timeline.quote: He's already bound himself to the Snarl.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts a group of Oriq with lightning, and Liliana pushes the soul out of an agent threatening her.
timeline.quote: With a savage thrust of will, she pushed it free of his body, which dropped in a heap on the floor.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus hits Liliana with a forced translocation spell that sends her to the forest outside campus.
timeline.quote: Forced translocation magic.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana returns to Strixhaven and the deans invite her to remain a professor indefinitely.
timeline.quote: they had invited her to remain a professor at the university indefinitely

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana puts away her research journals, parting from her old friend.
timeline.quote: It seems this is where we finally part, old friend.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana introduces herself to her class as Professor Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: My name is Professor Liliana Vess.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa smashes porcelain in a tantrum in the cathedral, having secured Thraben by eliminating most of the living after Liliana's zombies took it.
timeline.quote: The plate shattered against the wall

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana, a professor at Strixhaven, is visited in a dream by the Raven Man, who calls her to come home.
timeline.quote: "Come home , my Lili.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Hallucination or not, Liliana researches the Raven Man in the Biblioplex, where he appears again and urges her to search deeper.
timeline.quote: "You aren't going far enough back," he said.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds a name in A History of Terisiare, concludes the Raven Man is real, and resolves to destroy him for Gideon's sake.
timeline.quote: She could cleanse this tiny bit of evil from the Multiverse, for Gideon's sake.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana takes leave and planeswalks to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "All right, you bastard," she said. "I'm coming home."

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana arrives at the ruined Vess estate and falls asleep under the oak in the graveyard, where the Raven Man appears in a dream.
timeline.quote: the Raven Man stood before her

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana names him Lim-Dûl and learns he wants her as Dominaria's weapon against a threat; he warns her to save herself.
timeline.quote: I called you to be Dominaria's weapon.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.quote: "You have entered our gathering grounds, and you are thus forfeit."

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Elas il-Kor says her team is excavating to find an object anchoring the spirit; Liliana decides not to flee and to stop them.
timeline.quote: "The spirit we pursue is anchored to an object somewhere in this place,"

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the swamp's dead against the Phyrexians and retreats to her family graveyard.
timeline.quote: Liliana had the dead of an entire biome.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts the Phyrexians with rotting light; Elas throws a javelin that wounds Liliana's shoulder.
timeline.quote: it struck Liliana in the shoulder.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Reaching into the ring's power, Liliana sees the history of the Raven Man's necromancer lineage and that she was meant to be the next vessel, but refuses.
timeline.quote: She had been intended as one more link in a line stretching back to that first, now-nameless mage

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the dead Phyrexians against Elas il-Kor, who flees.
timeline.quote: Then, choosing survival over her soldiers' fate, she fled.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana buries the ring deeper beneath Dominaria to deny the Phyrexians and planeswalks back to Arcavios.
timeline.quote: she pushed the artifact downward, commanding the ancient dead to hide the object away

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man watches her leave, content that he manipulated her into protecting him.
timeline.quote: She had protected him, in the end.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers wait in Liliana's safe house on Dominaria for two weeks of word from the strike team.
timeline.quote: For two weeks they'll wait here in one of Liliana's cabins on Dominaria.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.
